_comment: Shrink-only ceiling for tracked files whose on-disk bytes differ from their committed bytes while git reports them unmodified. Regenerate with `python -m dev.audit.checkout_drift --write-baseline`. The default screen run never fails; `--check` applies this ceiling and is not wired into a blocking lane. 'buckets' are top-level path segments, so growth is attributable to a tree rather than only to the total.
